target.description: Category-conditioned referring-expression comprehension from fMRI: output object coordinates for known query classes. Preserve all four subjects and All-category primary scores; free object discovery, captioning and retrieval are distinct endpoints.

dataset.description: NSD-derived BrainHub using the original 982 shared images and COCO-derived coordinates. Native annotation version, transformation and stimulus-to-annotation identity join require immutable recovery; current BrainHub commit is not proven to be the paper-time artifact.

cohort.description: All completed-session subjects S1,S2,S5,S7. The shared-subject UMBRAE rows, not UMBRAE-Sx rows, are the source comparator.

split.description: Original training/test stimulus split: 24,980 training fMRI samples per subject; 982 held-out test stimuli common to the four trained subjects. These are stimulus-held-out, not unseen-subject, results.

inputs.description: Subject fMRI and known category-expression prompts; match source CLIP/Shikra/Vicuna pretrained access and allowed training images. Ground-truth test images/boxes are scorer-side, not candidate inputs.

preprocessing.description: Source averages repeated test fMRI and uses subject-specific voxel dimensions. Recover exact NSD normalization, ROI selection, COCO square-image box transform, order and checkpoint identities before admitting same-task equivalence.

metric.description: Per subject All-category acc@0.5 =100 times number of image/category queries with continuous box IoU strictly>0.5 divided by query count. Source uses the first reference box and first extracted prediction; missing outputs must not improve the denominator.

aggregation.description: Four separately reported per-subject All scores, with fixed salience groups/IoU as secondary diagnostics. The paper does not publish a single four-subject pooled success score; do not replace its result vector with a newly averaged scalar.

full_panel.description: Retain S1/S2/S5/S7 separately for all five source salience groups: strict IoU>0.3, >0.5 and >0.7 accuracy plus mean first-box IoU (80 source-grounded metric cells). The four All-category >0.5 values are documentary targets; the other companion values and publication-vintage panel membership remain unrecovered. Preserve full query-level neural-free/shuffled outputs and all four primary control scores per intervention; these controls are prospective task requirements with no invented published expected values. Complete source comparator-row and supplementary-panel obligations must be independently resolved before admission; Shikra image-input and subject-specific rows cannot silently replace shared-subject UMBRAE.

permitted_observations.description: Provide the same original permitted training data, subject fMRI, known category-expression queries, source prompt and declared CLIP/Shikra/Vicuna pretrained access in both information conditions. Test images, bounding boxes, per-query verifier targets and final score feedback remain operator-side. The paper+data+author-code condition may add only the frozen authentic author-code manifest; source outputs, learned answer-bearing artifacts and target annotations are not automatically permitted code.
